page_title: RMA 2-0 SEV | Real Madrid v Sevilla 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Peque (Sevilla) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+6' That's it for today, Alejandro Ruiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
90+5' Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla) strikes the ball towards the top right corner of the goal and raises his hands to celebrate, but the goalkeeper somehow manages to deny his attempt.
90+4' Substitution. Raul Asencio makes way for David Jimenez (Real Madrid).
90+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes the direct free kick from the edge of the box, but his shot flies wide of the target.
90+2' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Real Madrid, play can continue.

90+2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Real Madrid players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+1' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90+1' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The Real Madrid players are stunned as referee Alejandro Ruiz changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
89' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Real Madrid, he's going to review using VAR.

89' Oso (Sevilla) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Madrid are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
88' Oso (Sevilla) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
86' 2 - 0 GOAL! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Odysseas Vlachodimos.
86' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
85' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Ruiz signals a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Real Madrid!
84' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucien Agoume.
84' Substitution. Kike Salas (Sevilla) in, Jose Angel Carmona out.
84' Here is a change. Batista Mendy is going off and Matias Almeyda gives the last tactical orders to Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) will replace Vinicius Junior.
81' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.

81' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Sevilla have a free kick from a promising distance.

78' A wonderful opportunity! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top of the net. However, Odysseas Vlachodimos makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the bar.
77' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Oso (Sevilla) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Real Madrid hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
72' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Arda Guler is replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).

72' The opposition back off Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Odysseas Vlachodimos denies him with the save.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Peque (Sevilla) for Isaac Romero.
70' The attendance is 72062.
70' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) receives a yellow card.
68' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and Marcao (Sevilla) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.

67' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
66' The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.

66' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top left corner, but Thibaut Courtois has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
64' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
63' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Oso (Sevilla) coming on for Gabriel Suazo.
60' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

57' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) latches on to a perfectly taken corner kick deep into the box and attempts to head home. His bullet header heads straight towards the roof of the net, but it's deflected onto the crossbar by the goalkeeper. A wonderful effort.
57' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Thibaut Courtois.

52' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Thibaut Courtois, who tips the ball around the post.
51' A great run from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
50' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Matias Almeyda gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
45+3' Marcao (Sevilla) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+1' Looks like Marcao (Sevilla) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
41' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

38' 1 - 0 Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Rodrygo. He sends the ball inside the left post with his towering header and alters the score to 1:0.
38' It seemed like Rodrygo (Real Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
37' Marcao (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.

36' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
35' Referee Alejandro Ruiz has finally had enough of Matias Almeyda and brandishes a yellow card at him!
34' Real Madrid couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
34' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
32' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
27' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Batista Mendy (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
26' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
24' The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
23' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
23' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
21' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.

18' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
17' Chance! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
13' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
12' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.

5' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
5' The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.

4' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Odysseas Vlachodimos guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
3' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Now Sevilla have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Real Madrid will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Ruiz.
